stack.components_note: Inherited from the locked upstream. Operate does not choose a stack; it watches what Workflow 4 released.

constraints.autonomy_note: The tier an agent may act at is a human decision recorded in bands, never a default. See WORKFLOW.md.

delivery.population_note: Populated only from the locked Workflow 4 state. Never hand-filled.

incident.population_note: Written by the deterministic watcher, never by an agent. A breach an agent decided had happened is not a breach.

workflow_signoff.owner_note: Sign-off is cross-cutting and belongs to whoever drives the workflow, not to one specialist.

note: Workflow-level facts. Stage state lives in roles/. Never store stage output here.
